result_summary.title: Duplicate accounts created and sync stuck in SSO Integration Module
result_summary.description: We have identified an issue with the SSO Integration Module in our EU-Central staging environment. When users attempt to log in, duplicate accounts are sometimes created, and the synchronization process between our directory and the module gets stuck. This is affecting around 33 test users and preventing us from completing our integration testing. Please assist in resolving the duplicate account creation and un-sticking the sync.
